title: Domain-prioritized signal-weighted calibration bundles for production prompt populations
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a reproducible, domain-aware dataset curation and sampling strategy to produce calibration bundles for FP8 and INT8 quantization validation. These bundles ("calibration bundles") should reflect the real-world distribution of production prompts across domains, while up-weighting high-signal examples that drive quantization-induced accuracy regressions. Deliverables include generation scripts, bundle metadata, reproducible seeds, and an evaluation benchmark (holdout + continuous regression checks).
acceptance_criteria: 1) End-to-end scripts that produce per-domain calibration bundles with documented parameters and deterministic seeds. 2) Each domain bundle contains stratification metadata (length bins, token distribution, user-frequency buckets, temporal window) and a README. 3) Evaluation notebook showing FP8 and INT8 quantization runs vs float baseline with pre-specified metrics (macro accuracy, domain-wise delta, and targeted task metrics). 4) Regression alert thresholds configured in the eval dashboard. 5) Security/data-privacy sign-off recorded.
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Data signals and schema definition (2 sprints). Phase 2: Sampling engine implementation + deterministic reservoir with decay (1 sprint). Phase 3: Bundle generation and spot-check evaluations (1 sprint). Phase 4: Full benchmark runs, integration with eval dashboards, and handoff to model ops (1 sprint). Will use existing data exports in s3://redwood-prod/calibration-exports and conform to PII redaction rules.
sampling_algorithm_spec: We will implement a signal-weighted sampling pipeline combining: 1) domain-prioritization: partition production prompts by domain tag and allocate proportional budget based on 90-day traffic with a floor for low-volume domains; 2) signal weighting: compute per-prompt signal score = alpha * user_frequency_rank + beta * recentness_decay + gamma * model-disagreement_score + delta * edge-case-heuristic. Default weights (alpha,beta,gamma,delta) = (0.4,0.2,0.3,0.1) and configurable per-run. 3) deterministic reservoir sampling within each domain with exponential decay (lambda) to prefer recent examples while preserving older anchors. 4) length and token stratification: enforce quotas across short/medium/long bins to match production distribution. 5) adversarial overlay: inject a small fraction (configurable, default 3%) of synthetically perturbed prompts to stress quantization-sensitive patterns. 6) downsampling cap to avoid over-representation of heavy users (max 5 prompts/user per bundle). Outputs: bundle manifest CSV and JSONL of examples with provenance fields.
validation_plan: Holdout: reserve 15% of recent production prompts per domain (non-overlapping). Run baseline (float32) and quantized variants (INT8 symmetric/asymmetric, FP8/e4m3) across three seeds. Metrics: domain macro-delta on task-specific KPI (accuracy/EM/F1), perplexity shift on generative tasks, and token-level distribution drift. Accept if median domain-delta < pre-commit thresholds (P0: 0.5% absolute, P1: 1.2%). If delta exceeds thresholds, run per-example attribution to identify failing shards and iterate on sampling weights and adversarial patterns. Integrate results into console eval dashboard and create automatic regression tickets when thresholds are crossed.
